scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --packages external --sourcemap=none
scripts.prepublish:check: bun changeset status && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:integration && bun run build && node --input-type=module -e "const mod = await import('./dist/index.js'); if (typeof mod.HonoAdapter !== 'function') throw new Error('HonoAdapter export missing')" && bun --eval "const mod = await import('./dist/index.js'); if (typeof mod.HonoAdapter !== 'function') throw new Error('HonoAdapter export missing')" && npm pack --dry-run
